ev.q: During 2018, FoodNet identified 25,606 cases of infection, 5,893 hospitalizations, and 120 deaths.
Compared with 2015–2017, the incidence significantly increased for Cyclospora (399%)
Incidence per 100,000 population was calculated by dividing the number of infections in 2018
In 2018, the percentage of infections diagnosed by DNA-based syndrome panels was highest for Yersinia (68%)
The incidence of infection (per 100,000 population) was highest for Campylobacter (19.5) and Salmonella (18.3)
Compared with 2015–2017, the incidence significantly increased for Cyclospora (399%)
FoodNet conducts active, population-based surveillance for laboratory-diagnosed infections
The incidence of most infections increased during 2018 compared with 2015–2017

methods_quotes.q: A negative binomial model with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) was calculated using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) to estimate changes in incidence.
Incidence per 100,000 population was calculated by dividing the number of infections in 2018 by U.S. Census estimates of the surveillance area population for 2017.
